metrics.note: Pywr is a water allocation optimizer, not a hydrological model — standard NSE/KGE metrics against observed Q are not applicable. Instead, supply/demand metrics are used.

issues: S4 tool (convert_vic_to_inflow) only handles VIC output — had to manually prepare inflow CSV from observed Q data
Observed Q has -99 missing data flags that needed cleaning (365 days in 1980-1990)
Observed Q file uses GBK encoding — not handled automatically
ki_gaps: KI GAP 1: No tool for observed-data-as-inflow. S4 only converts VIC output. Need a tool like convert_obs_to_inflow.py that reads standard obs formats (stcd/dates/Q tab-sep) and handles missing data flags (-99), encoding (GBK/UTF-8), and date gap filling.

KI GAP 2: No guidance on using entire basin Q as proxy inflow when dam upstream area (1,094 km2) differs from observed station drainage area (30,630 km2). Should recommend area-scaling: Q_dam = Q_obs * (dam_area / station_area).
KI GAP 3: No tool for multi-reservoir modeling. Wangjiaba basin has 7 dams — KI pipeline only handles one reservoir. Need multi-reservoir network assembly.
KI GAP 4: No automated demand estimation from basin properties. User must guess irrigated area, population, etc. Could auto-estimate from basin area, land cover, and regional statistics.
KI GAP 5: S5 operating rules are generic seasonal profiles. No tool to ingest actual published/historical operating rules for known Chinese reservoirs.
